description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class RpcV1Controller for handling RPC requests in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for sending one-way and two-way RPC requests to devices, with deprecated annotations indicating it is an older version.

classes.name: RpcV1Controller
classes.description: A REST controller for handling RPC requests to devices, supporting deprecated one-way and two-way RPC endpoints.

methods.name: handleOneWayDeviceRPCRequestV1
methods.description: Handles deprecated one-way RPC requests to a device, identified by deviceId, with request body as JSON.

methods.name: handleTwoWayDeviceRPCRequestV1
methods.description: Handles deprecated two-way RPC requests to a device, identified by deviceId, with request body as JSON.
